reasoning: The question asks whether the overnight bank funding rate (OBFR) will increase between October 26 and November 2, 2025. The evidence indicates the Fed cut rates in September 2025 (from 4.25%-4.50% to 4.00%-4.25%) and an October 29 FOMC meeting is scheduled. Multiple sources suggest the Fed may cut rates again in October, with expectations for two total cuts by year-end. The OBFR typically tracks Fed policy closely. If the Fed cuts rates on October 29, the OBFR would likely decrease, not increase. The evidence provides no indication of rate increases in late October/early November. The timeframe (Oct 26 to Nov 2) spans the October 29 FOMC decision, which markets expect to result in a rate cut or hold, not an increase. This makes an increase in OBFR unlikely.
